_comment: Prompt = styles[selected or candidate] + ', ' + subject + ', ' + framing. Qwen-Image ignores negatives (L40S, 2026-11-12), so framing describes what we want; negative is still sent for models that use it. See docs/EMOJI_SET_PLAN.md §6.

styles.marker: hand-drawn illustration in felt-tip marker and coloured pencil, confident visible strokes, slightly uneven dark brown ink outline, bold flat colours with light paper grain inside the shapes
styles.paper: cut-paper collage illustration, layered coloured paper shapes, slightly rough hand-cut edges, soft shadow between the layers, gouache texture
styles.clay: soft 3D clay figure, rounded matte plasticine shapes, gentle studio light, vivid colours, subtle fingerprint texture

framing: one single isolated subject shown whole, centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame, floating in empty space in front of a plain flat medium grey background
negative: text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, logo, frame, border, white sticker outline, several subjects, cropped subject, photograph, realistic human skin, extra fingers, missing fingers

seed._formula: seed = base + per_item * n + k; k = 0..3 (hands category 0..7), retries continue with the next k
